A one-way ratchet over source sites that use a Node API newer than the repository's OWN declared floor. `engines.node` is `^20.19.0 || >=22.13.0` and `.nvmrc` is `20.19.0`, so the floor a consumer's engine check reads is 20.19.0 -- and two files use `fs.globSync`, which is `@since v22.0.0`.
